The structure of Ba4Mn8Ge16 (reduced formula BaMn2Ge4) is tetragonal with space group I-4m2 (No. 119), containing 28 atoms per unit cell across four independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-only CrystalNN analysis shows Ge and Mn centers each with 10 geometric neighbors (Ge/Mn ratios 8:2 and 4:6, respectively), while Ba centers have 16 neighbors. A single three-dimensional geometric neighbor-graph component spans all 28 sites. Validated polyhedron contacts reveal corner- and edge-sharing between Ge 10-vertex polyhedra and between Ba 16-vertex polyhedra, alongside corner- and face-sharing between Ba and Ge polyhedra.
